name: sealeap-amazon-scalable-seller-operating-system
description: Design a scalable Amazon seller operating system using category specialization, portfolio capacity, operator skill tiers, SOP floors, experiment governance, incentives, and resource allocation. Use when the user asks how a small team can manage more products, improve operator productivity, allocate launches, or balance expert autonomy with standardized processes. Do not repeat anecdotal revenue claims as benchmarks.
